q01_client_filter_comparison.query: How do I recover an ArgoCD Application whose operation is stuck at phase Running with finishedAt set when I am off-LAN without kubectl?
q01_client_filter_comparison.purpose: Issue #6956 verification step 2: does the scoped limit=20 list equal the head of the unscoped limit=50 list filtered client-side to the same scope?
q01_client_filter_comparison.score_jitter_note: The same five notes scored 0.0001 to 0.0003 lower in the unscoped call than in the scoped call. The two notes that swapped ranks 2 and 3 were 0.0002 apart in the scoped call (0.43158 and 0.43137) and 0.0004 apart, in the opposite order, in the unscoped call (0.43151 and 0.43114).
q01_client_filter_comparison.conclusion: The scope filter discarded nothing: the unscoped call with limit 50 returned only 5 candidates, all in the requested scope, so q01 is short with or without scope. The note id set is identical. The order differs by one adjacent swap at ranks 2 and 3, a near-tie within score jitter between calls, so the lists are equal as sets and not as ordered sequences.
